items.title: Realign stale assertions across all failing smokes
items.context: For each smoke that fails on a fresh main checkout under both `npm run test:all` (parallel) and `node packages/main/dist/tasks/<name>-smoke.js` (single), update the offending assertion to match current production behavior. Preserve assertion INTENT (what the test is checking) but match TEXT/REGEX/ENUM to current output. DO NOT modify production source. If a failure is rooted in production-side regression (test was correct, prod drifted in a way that should be reverted), file finding_add with severity=high and leave the smoke as-is for the follow-up story.

items.title: Diagnose + fix lattice-baseline TIMEOUT
items.context: lattice-baseline-smoke times out at the 60s default. Three real remedies (all use existing smoke-manifest.json schema fields {name, tags?, timeoutMs?, skip?}): (a) genuinely slow → raise the smoke's timeoutMs entry in packages/main/smoke-manifest.json (e.g. 120000); (b) deadlock/hang → file finding_add severity=high with diagnosis, then either (b1) set skip:true on the manifest entry until the deadlock is fixed in a follow-up production story or (b2) leave skip:false and accept the failure (deferred to follow-up); (c) parallel-race that disappears under --jobs 1 → keep timeoutMs default but document the smoke as requires-serial in a code comment; if the runner ever adds a 'serial' tag the smoke can opt into it then. Pick the remedy that matches the diagnosis; document choice in CHANGELOG.
